# abstractcode

> abstractcode is a reactive terminal client for the AbstractGateway
> control plane, built on the AbstractTUI rendering engine. The coding agent
> runs durably on the gateway; this binary starts runs (the gateway's
> default agent workflow unless you pick one), streams their ledgers live
> (SSE with a polling fallback) and, when the gateway supports it, the
> model's reply as it is written; renders reasoning cycles, tool cards that
> update in place, markdown answers and generated images; resolves
> tool-approval and ask-user waits through focus-trapped modals (with a
> persisted read/write/all auto-approval tier plus per-tool pins); steers
> the agent mid-run, queues follow-up prompts, attaches files to prompts
> (`/attach`, a file browser, or drag & drop), browses and previews the
> run's workspace on the gateway host (`/files`), and keeps a durable
> session whose history the gateway replays server-side. It also talks
> with gateway-hosted summoned entities (`@name`). One crate, three
> dependencies (abstracttui, ureq, serde_json). MIT licensed.

## Core docs

- [README](README.md): The pitch, a rendered-screen sketch, install,
  quickstart, the workspace-policy note, and how this client relates to the
  browser client.
- [Getting started](docs/getting-started.md): Install to first run —
  `login`, `doctor`, the first approval, steering, sessions, the gateway
  default workflow, `/model` with reasoning and MTP, streamed replies,
  where files land, themes, entities, permissions, headless one-shots,
  exports, and attachments.
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): The thin-client design — threading
  contract (UI thread owns signals; a worker owns HTTP; WakeHandle posts),
  the ledger fold, SSE/polling transports, live reply deltas, wait
  resolution, module map, testing model, known limits.
- [Reference](docs/api.md): Every CLI option and env var (including
  `--workflow default`, `--stream`, `--mtp`), slash commands
  (including `/workflow`, `/files`, `/stream`, `/about`, `/model`, `/mtp`,
  `/workspace send`, `@name`, `/entities`, `/task`, `/end`, `/queue`, `/goal`,
  `/permissions`, `/workspace`, `/attach`, `/export`, `/context`, `/gpu`,
  `/resources`, `/redraw`), key bindings (incl. `Ctrl+L` repaint, `Ctrl+J` newline,
  `Ctrl+O` drop-undo, `Alt+E` conversation focus, the composer's editor
  chords, `?` reference), the type-to-focus rule (typing, pasting or
  dropping a file returns focus to the composer and keeps the input),
  per-modal keys, transcript glyph
  vocabulary, attachments custody rules, exec exit codes, and prompt-cache
  posture (`exec --no-prompt-cache`, its scope, and how to verify the lane).
- [FAQ](docs/faq.md): Durability, workspace policy and files, token stats,
  steering semantics, queue pause semantics, approval tiers, parallel
  sessions, the gateway default workflow, prompt-cache A/B.
- [Troubleshooting](docs/troubleshooting.md): Symptom → cause → fix for
  connection, auth, catalog and default workflow, provider, workspace,
  `/files`, streaming, and rendering issues.
- [Orchestration cards](docs/orchestration-cards.md): One card per coding
  workflow accepted by `--workflow` — anatomy, how each decides it is done,
  what it remembers, measured profile, and when to choose it.
- [Documentation index](docs/README.md): One-line map of every page.

## Project

- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md): Release history, from 0.1.0 (the first
  application built on AbstractTUI) through 0.6.0 (gateway default workflow,
  live replies, workspace files, About).
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): Build/test gates, live verification and
  the benchmark smoke mode, the layering rules (signal ownership, pure
  protocol layer, replay-safe fold), which test to write for which change.
- [Security policy](SECURITY.md): Private reporting; credentials at rest
  (0600 login store) and in transit; untrusted-render-input scope.
- [Acknowledgements](ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS.md): The three dependencies and the
  sibling projects (AbstractGateway, the Python abstractcode).
- [License](LICENSE): MIT.

## Code entry points

- [src/lib.rs](src/lib.rs): Crate root with the layer map and `run_cli`.
- [src/protocol.rs](src/protocol.rs): Pure extraction over gateway ledger
  records — the protocol contract in one file.
- [src/transcript.rs](src/transcript.rs): The fold from records to
  transcript items, stats, and pending waits.
- [src/live.rs](src/live.rs): Live reply state from `llm.delta` /
  `llm.delta_end` frames.
- [src/runner.rs](src/runner.rs): The worker thread owning every HTTP call
  and per-run stream thread.
- [src/ui/](src/ui/mod.rs): AbstractTUI views — chrome, transcript pane,
  modals.
- [tests/headless_ui.rs](tests/headless_ui.rs): The real interface driven
  through AbstractTUI's capture harness (the pattern for UI tests).
- [scripts/pty_live_smoke.py](scripts/pty_live_smoke.py): Live end-to-end
  proof against a running gateway.
